Tasks 0-5: scripts/fuzz_external.py --fuzzer fuzzsmt --solver build-slurm-fuzz/primo --quiet --refs z3 --logic QF_UF --count 500 --timeout 5 --seed 500000+shard --fuzzer-args "-ms 1 -Ms 2 -mv 1 -Mv 2 -mf 1 -mp 1 -ma 1 -Ma 2". entries.notes: This is the current-head gate that uses both Brummayer/Biere FuzzSMT and the YinYang package. The installed typefuzz entry point was also smoke-tested but hit internal QF_UF seed handling errors (custom-sort seed raised msg 'A'; Bool seed raised 'argument of type Term is not iterable'), so the successful YinYang-package coverage here is from opfuzz plus semantic-fusion yinyang. Primo binary reports git 5de60d9 and CaDiCaL cadical-3.0.0-7b99c07. CaDiCaL rel-1.9.5 versus rel-3.0.0 comparison remains logged separately as 2026-07-18-cadical-version-sat-heavy-0ef55b8 and should be repeated after solver-code changes, not after ledger-only commits.

entries.scope: Local inspection of QG iso_* performance gaps and setup of iso-specific SMAC manifests/search space
entries.command: Rebuilt build/primo, ranked iso_* rows from results/qg-raw-amo-slurm-2905733/merged.csv against historical LLM2SMT/Z3/cvc5 CSVs, ran bounded option ablations on tmp/QF_UF/QG-classification/qg7/iso_brn_repgen033.smt2, and smoke-ran build/primo --quiet --qf-uf-preprocess=basic over benchmarks/qfuf-smac-iso-{train,validate}.txt
entries.notes: Primo already flattens and/or terms during TermManager construction and finite-domain choice collection walks nested or nodes. No NNF pass was found in preprocessing, so NNF remains a plausible future implementation target, but the strongest immediate local signal on iso_brn_repgen033 is that default finite-domain AMO/search interaction is harmful while basic preprocessing matches the LLM2SMT timing scale. The SMAC search space was extended to tune theory phase, finite-domain value precedence/equality definitions, bounded ground congruence, and EUF engine in addition to existing QF_UF knobs.

The run should be collected before making any default/profile recommendation.
